arxiv-2103-04103.title: Rheology of mobile sediment beds in laminar shear flow: effects of creep and polydispersity
arxiv-2103-04103.creator: Christoph Rettinger 1, Sebastian Eibl 1, Ulrich Rüde 1,2, Bernhard Vowinckel 3
arxiv-2103-04103.description: Abstract Classical scaling relationships for rheological quantities such as the μ ⁡ ( J ) \mu(J) -rheology have become increasingly popular for closures of two-phase flow modeling. However, these frameworks have been derived for monodisperse particles. We aim to extend these considerations to sediment transport modeling by using a more realistic sediment composition.

arxiv-2108-12763.title: Non-trivial extensions in equivariant cohomology with constant coefficients
arxiv-2108-12763.creator: Samik Basu, Surojit Ghosh
arxiv-2108-12763.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove some computational results about equivariant cohomology over the cyclic group C p n C_{p^{n}} of prime power order. We show that there is an inductive formula when the dimension of the C p C_{p} -fixed points of the grading is large.

arxiv-2109-08963.title: SDTP: Semantic-aware Decoupled Transformer Pyramid for Dense Image Prediction
arxiv-2109-08963.creator: Zekun Li, Yufan Liu, Bing Li, Weiming Hu, Kebin Wu, Pei Wang
arxiv-2109-08963.description: Abstract Although transformer has achieved great progress on computer vision tasks, the scale variation in dense image prediction is still the key challenge. Few effective multi-scale techniques are applied in transformer and there are two main limitations in the current methods.

arxiv-2203-13878.title: Avaliação dos impactos da decomposição de uma aplicação monolítica para microsserviços: Um estudo de caso DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2203-13878.creator: Tulio Ricardo Hoppen Barzotto, Kleinner Farias
arxiv-2203-13878.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tulio Ricardo Hoppen Barzotto, Kleinner Farias. Aplicações monolíticas estão sendo decompostas para uma arquitetura de microsserviços, visando melhorar a manutenabilidade, perfomance e modularização. Embora tais decomposições tenham sido amplamente realizadas atualmente na indústria, pouco é reportado na literatura sobre os impactos destas decomposições. Este trabalho, portanto, reporta um estudo de caso realizado para investigar os impactos da decomposição de uma aplicação real da indústria para a arquitetura de microsserviços.

arxiv-2412-16716.title: Resource Allocation Influence on Application Performance in Sliced Testbeds
arxiv-2412-16716.creator: Rodrigo Moreira 1, Larissa F. Rodrigues Moreira 1,2, Tereza C. Carvalho 3
arxiv-2412-16716.description: Abstract Modern network architectures have shaped market segments, governments, and communities with intelligent and pervasive applications. Ongoing digital transformation through technologies such as softwarization, network slicing, and AI drives this evolution, along with research into Beyond 5G (B5G) and 6G architectures. Network slices require seamless management, observability, and intelligent-native resource allocation, considering user satisfaction, cost efficiency, security, and energy.

arxiv-2504-07097.title: Sculpting Subspaces: Constrained Full Fine-Tuning in LLMs for Continual Learning
arxiv-2504-07097.creator: Nikhil Shivakumar Nayak, Krishnateja Killamsetty, Ligong Han, Abhishek Bhandwaldar, Prateek Chanda, Kai Xu, Hao Wang, Aldo Pareja, Oleg Silkin, Mustafa Eyceoz, Akash Srivastava
arxiv-2504-07097.description: Abstract Continual learning in large language models (LLMs) is prone to catastrophic forgetting, where adapting to new tasks significantly degrades performance on previously learned ones. Existing methods typically rely on low-rank, parameter-efficient updates that limit the model’s expressivity and introduce additional parameters per task, leading to scalability issues.

pmc-11382323.title: Dataset of 313 metagenome-assemble genomes from streamer hot spring water
pmc-11382323.creator: Jia Hao Tan, Kok Jun Liew, Kian Mau Goh
pmc-11382323.description: This data report presents prokaryotic metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) from a hot spring stream with temperatures between 64 and 100°C. The stream water was filtered and the extracted total DNA was sequenced using the Illumina HiSeq 2500 platform. Approximately 80 Gb of raw data were generated, which were subsequently assembled using MEGAHIT v1.2.9.

pmc-11408467.title: Enhancing wound healing with zinc and silver nanocomposites synthesized with β-lactoglobulin: antimicrobial properties, collagen deposition, and systemic effects in a C57BL/6J mouse model
pmc-11408467.creator: Agnieszka Rodzik, Paweł Pomastowski, Magdalena Buszewska-Forajta, Viorica Railean, Adrian Gołębiowski, Bogusław Buszewski, Katarzyna Niedojadło, Paweł Fijałkowski, Kinga Robotnik, Katarzyna Rafińska
pmc-11408467.description: This study explores the potential of zinc and silver nanocomposites, synthesized with β-lactoglobulin, a whey protein, in promoting wound healing, using the C57BL/6J mouse model. Our research is distinct in its dual focus: assessing the antimicrobial efficacy of these nanocomposites and their impact on wound healing processes.

pmc-12280840.title: Development and Validation of a Rapid LC–MS/MS Method for Plasma Analysis of Ketamine, Norketamine, Dehydronorketamine, and Hydroxynorketamine
pmc-12280840.creator: Jan Thomann, Selina Kraus, Livio Erne, Severin B. Vogt, Matthias E. Liechti, Dino Luethi
pmc-12280840.description: Ketamine, a well‐established dissociative anesthetic, has recently gained significant attention for its rapid‐acting antidepressant effects, particularly in treatment‐resistant depression. In this study, we developed and validated a state‐of‐the‐art liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) method for the bioanalysis of ketamine and its metabolites, norketamine, dehydronorketamine (DHNK), and (2R,6R)‐hydroxynorketamine (HNK), in human plasma.

pmc-12419978.creator: Mona Duggal, Anshul Chauhan, Vishali Gupta, Ankita Kankaria, Deepmala Budhija, Priyanka Verma, Vaibhav Miglani, Preeti Syal, Gagandeep Kaur, Lakshay Kumar, Naveen Mutyala, Rishabh Bezbaruah, Nayanshi Sood, Ashleigh Kernohan, Geeta Menon, Luke Vale
pmc-12419978.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI) algorithms offer an effective solution to alleviate the burden of diabetic retinopathy (DR) screening in public health settings. However, there are challenges in translating diagnostic performance and its application when deployed in real-world conditions.ObjectiveThis study aimed to assess the technical feasibility of integration and diagnostic performance of validated DR screening (DRS) AI algorithms in real-world outpatient public health settings.MethodsPrior to integrating an AI algorithm for DR screening, the study involved several steps: (1) Five AI companies, including four from

pmc-12432252.title: Meltwater ponding has an underestimated radiative effect on the surface of the Greenland Ice Sheet
pmc-12432252.creator: Jonathan C. Ryan, Matthew G. Cooper, Sarah W. Cooley, Åsa K. Rennermalm, Laurence C. Smith
pmc-12432252.description: Ponding of meltwater on the surface of the Greenland Ice Sheet has the potential to reduce ice sheet albedo and amplify mass loss. However, this process remains poorly constrained and is absent from models that project ice sheet mass balance. Here we demonstrate that meltwater ponding considerably increases the amount of energy available for melting the Greenland Ice Sheet.

pmc-12542289.title: Successful management of neonatal tetanus with autonomic manifestations at a referral hospital in Nigeria: a case report
pmc-12542289.creator: Chigozie K Onyeje, Blessing Tochukwu Onyeje
pmc-12542289.description: BackgroundNeonatal tetanus remains a significant cause of preventable neonatal death in developing countries like Nigeria. With case fatality rates approaching 100% in resource-poor settings, improved antenatal tetanus vaccination and clean delivery practices can drastically reduce mortality. Each case of neonatal tetanus highlights major gaps in public health systems, especially where umbilical sepsis and maternal non-vaccination are common.

pmc-12835158.title: Research on the water migration law in ion-adsorbed rare earth ores based on the high-density resistivity method
pmc-12835158.creator: Gang Li, Kailong Huang, Hao Wang, Xiaojun Wang, Zhiqiang Zou, Jiacheng Lu, Lingbo Zhou, Fucheng Xiao
pmc-12835158.description: High-intensity liquid injection is a key factor influencing the deformation and instability of slopes in ion-adsorbed rare earth ores. Current research on water migration in slopes primarily relies on point-to-point monitoring using sensors, which limits the ability to comprehensively monitor the ore body.

pmc-12958817.title: Genetics of retroactive measures of stress response in pigs before and after exposure to a disease challenge
pmc-12958817.creator: Fazhir Kayondo, Hayder Al-Shanoon, Yolande M Seddon, Dylan Carette, Carmen Cole, David M Janz, Frederic Fortin, John C S Harding, Michael K Dyck, Graham S Plastow, Pig Gen Canada, Jack C M Dekkers
pmc-12958817.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study explored the genetics of cortisol (CL), cortisone (CN), DHEA (DH), and DHEA-S (DS) in hair of 610 pigs that were grown while they were exposed to infectious stressors (IS) from a natural polymicrobial disease challenge. Results were then contrasted with previous results on hair from these same pigs grown while experiencing noninfectious stressors (NIS), such as weaning, castration, transportation, and mixing. All pigs were genotyped for 50 K SNPs and imputed to 650 K SNPs.

pmc-13164543.title: A Highly Protective Live-Attenuated Vaccine Generated by Targeted Deletion of the Mycobacterium bovis Virulence Factor VapC40
pmc-13164543.creator: Xin Ge, Haoran Wang, Dingpu Liu, Yuhui Dong, Lin Li, Puxiu Shen, Yue Li, Jiaming Zhang, Xiangmei Zhou, Ruichao Yue
pmc-13164543.description: Type II toxin–antitoxin (TA) systems are significantly expanded in the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex; however, the functional role of the VapBC40 system in Mycobacterium bovis (M. bovis) pathogenesis remains poorly characterized. This study aimed to investigate the role of VapBC40 in mycobacterial virulence and evaluate its potential as a target for rational vaccine attenuation.

pmc-13224832.title: Hemodiafiltration beyond the CONVINCE trial
pmc-13224832.creator: Giovanni F M Strippoli, Krister Cromm, Vasileios C Pezoulas, Nikolaos Tachos, Dimitrios I Fotiadis, Allison Jaure, Jolanta Malyszko, Michael Anger, Felix Fischer, Jörgen Hegbrant, Sagar Nigwekar, Rümeyza Kazancıoğlu
pmc-13224832.description: Online hemodiafiltration (HDF) is a dialysis modality that can improve patient outcomes beyond those achieved with conventional high-flux hemodialysis (HD) in patients with kidney failure. The CONVINCE trial, the latest and the largest of a series of randomized trials comparing HDF with HD, demonstrated a 23% reduction in the risk of all-cause mortality with high-volume HDF compared to high-flux HD.

pmc-13243318.title: Expulsion of rope-like material per rectum in an infant: a rare case report of pseudomembranous colitis
pmc-13243318.creator: Ahmad Hosiian, Mostafa Hassan, Ali ghanem, Mohamed Alafandi, Hayan Ghanem, Alaa Alani
pmc-13243318.description: Pseudomembranous colitis (PMC) is a severe manifestation of Clostridioides difficile infection and is exceedingly rare in early infancy. We report a unique case of a 2-month-old male infant who presented with fever, profuse watery diarrhea, vomiting, and the passage of multiple rope-like colonic mucosal casts in the stool, initially raising concern for intestinal parasitosis.

pmc-13556762.title: 689. What genetics research has told us about the mechanisms of mood disorders
pmc-13556762.creator: A Mcintosh
pmc-13556762.description: BackgroundPrior to the advent of large scale genome wide association studies, substantial investments generally failed to reveal major insights into the genetic architecture of mood disorders. Reasons for this include a lack of methodological and data harmonisation, small study sizes and a lack of replication, collaboration and meta-analysis.

pmc-13587760.title: Histopathological and Ultrastructural Evaluation of Buccinator Muscle Alterations in Oral Submucous Fibrosis: A Descriptive Light and Transmission Electron Microscopic Study

pmc-13669879.title: Case series of hemostatic outcomes of defect closure using a novel anchor-pronged clip after gastric endoscopic submucosal dissection
pmc-13669879.creator: Kenichiro Okimoto, Tomoaki Matsumura, Shohei Mukai, Tsubasa Ishikawa, Akane Kurosugi, Michiko Sonoda, Tatsuya Kaneko, Yuki Ohta, Takashi Taida, Keisuke Matsusaka, Jun-ichiro Ikeda, Jun Kato
pmc-13669879.description: Background and AimsDelayed bleeding (DB), occurring in 4.1% to 8.5% of gastric endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) cases, is one of the most common adverse events. The aim of this study was to evaluate whether defect closure using the novel anchor-pronged clip after gastric ESD contributes to the prevention of DB.
